BACKGROUND: a perfectly uniform flat saturated chroma green #00FF00 matte, also in every internal gap between limbs, under armpits, through tears, around tails and between cloth strips, for technical extraction. NO checkerboard, no background texture, no gradient, no black/white canvas, no cast shadows outside the character, no text, labels, borders or grid lines. This is an atlas of distinct sprites, not a poster. High resolution 2048x1024.
